biography: Steven Brady, a name now synonymous with aggressive overtakes and late-braking maneuvers, hails from the unassuming town of Brackley, the heart of British motorsport. Growing up, he wasn't surrounded by wealth or racing pedigree; his father, a mechanic, instilled in him a love for engines and the pursuit of speed. Brady's entry into racing was unconventional – initially, he competed in local karting events, funded by his father's tireless work and Brady's own efforts in repairing lawnmowers. His raw talent quickly became apparent, and a defining moment came at the age of 18 when he won the National Karting Championship against all odds, catching the eye of a small racing team. After a successful stint in GT racing, he found himself behind the wheel of an Ultima GTR, relishing the car's raw power and challenging handling. Now, at the peak of his career, Brady is looking to prove his worth in high-stakes endurance racing.
drivingStyle: Brady's driving style is best described as 'controlled aggression.' He's known for his daring overtakes, often pushing the limits of the car and the patience of his competitors. While some might see him as reckless, his calculated risks often pay off, allowing him to gain crucial positions. He has a knack for finding grip where others can't, using every inch of the track to his advantage. Tire management isn't his strongest suit, often favoring outright speed over long-term strategy, but under pressure, he thrives, relishing the challenge of close wheel-to-wheel racing.

rivalries.name: Alessandro Rossi
rivalries.reason: A clash of egos and driving styles led to several on-track incidents, fueling a heated rivalry that extends beyond the track.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: Dubois, a calculated and strategic driver, often criticizes Brady's aggressive approach, leading to a professional, yet frosty, relationship.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka and Brady had a controversial finish at Silverstone where Brady forced Tanaka off the track on the last corner.

quirks: Always wears the same worn-out driving gloves, claiming they bring him luck.
Listens to heavy metal music at full volume right before every race.
Has a habit of tapping the steering wheel three times before the green flag drops.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about being polite; it's about being faster. If you're not pushing the limit, you're not trying hard enough."
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours in 2022, overcoming a mechanical issue in the final hours and a relentless challenge from his rivals, is considered his greatest achievement.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2021 Bathurst 12 Hour due to a late mechanical failure remains a painful memory that haunts him.
